values.meaning: duration of zombie state after death
values.quote: Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Karthus''' enters a '''{{tip|zombie state}}''' for 7 seconds

mechanics.claim: During Death Defied, Karthus can cast abilities at no cost.
mechanics.quote: he can cast his abilities at no cost

mechanics.claim: If Defile has been learned, it remains toggled on for the entire duration of Death Defied.
mechanics.quote: If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration.

mechanics.claim: Requiem becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the Death Defied duration have elapsed.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Requiem|Karthus}}'' becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.

mechanics.claim: While in this state, Karthus is untargetable and prevents all incoming damage, but cannot move or basic attack.
mechanics.quote: becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare {{tip|basic attacks}}

mechanics.claim: At the start of Death Defied, Karthus is set to 1 health and always dies at the end of it.
mechanics.quote: At the start of ''Death Defied'', '''Karthus''' is set to {{sti|health|{{as|1 health}}}}.
